items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] His son was in it, too.

ctx.x: Well, his brother was a best big publisher.
His son was in it, too.

But these five tunes, I wrote, and I think I recorded them with a small group. Didn't come out to anything, but still, I didn't hear anything from the Mills Music Company. I guess when I die, they'll bring it out.
